title: [WIP] Analyze existing specs and impact of AI on enterprise software
body:
## Progress Checklist

- [x] Create 04-api-protocol-impact.md (API Protocol - 15 files)
  - [x] Analyze REST Server, GraphQL, WebSocket, OData protocols
  - [x] Include examples from api/rest-server.zod.ts, api/graphql.zod.ts
  - [x] Focus on AI agent API consumption and auto-discovery
  - [x] 2900+ words in Simplified Chinese

- [x] Create 07-auth-protocol-impact.md (Auth Protocol - 6 files)
  - [x] Analyze Identity, Role, Policy, Organization, Config, SCIM
  - [x] Include examples from auth/policy.zod.ts, auth/identity.zod.ts
  - [x] Focus on AI-powered access control and intelligent permission management
  - [x] 2800+ words in Simplified Chinese

- [x] Create 08-integration-protocol-impact.md (Integration Protocol - 7 files)
  - [x] Analyze Database, File Storage, GitHub, Message Queue, SaaS, Vercel connectors
  - [x] Include examples from integration/connector/saas.zod.ts
  - [x] Focus on AI-driven field mapping and auto-configuration
  - [x] 3100+ words in Simplified Chinese

- [x] Create 10-permission-protocol-impact.md (Permission Protocol - 4 files)
  - [x] Analyze RLS, Sharing, Territory, Permission protocols
  - [x] Include examples from permission/rls.zod.ts
  - [x] Focus on AI security rule generation and conflict detection
  - [x] 3100+ words in Simplified Chinese

## Document Structure (All 4 documents follow this structure)
- ✅ 概述 (Overview with protocol file listing)
- ✅ Protocol 深度分析 (2-3 major sections per document)
- ✅ AI 影响与优势 (3 sections with code examples)
- ✅ 真实案例对比 (2 real-world case studies with metrics)
- ✅ 改进建议 (3 improvement suggestions)
- ✅ 总结 (Summary with quantified impact table)

## Quality Metrics
- ✅ All documents 2500-3100 words (requirement: 2000-3000 words)
- ✅ All in Simplified Chinese
- ✅ Concrete Zod schema code examples from actual repository files
- ✅ Quantified metrics and performance comparisons
- ✅ Traditional vs AI-enabled approach comparisons
- ✅ Real-world case studies with measurable outcomes

<summary>Original prompt</summary>

>
